capabilities: Match equivalent CJK characters in vault Search and in-note Find
Extend Quick switcher matching to file names, paths, and aliases
Extend Graph view filters, groups, and path/file/tag queries
Extend tag and internal-link suggestions after # and [[
Match folder names in the native move dialogue
extras: Manual installation from GitHub Releases (zip into .obsidian/plugins); flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and reliant on internal Obsidian interfaces, so the author recommends testing in a scratch vault. Detailed limitations list (unsupported surfaces, input-size fallbacks, untested platforms) is in the README.
intentEvidence: CJK Search extends Obsidian’s native Search, Find, Quick switcher, move dialogue, Graph view, and editor suggestions.
problem: Obsidian's native search treats visually equivalent CJK characters (e.g. 体 vs 體) and compatibility forms as different, so equivalent notes and files are missed.

relations.evidence: Character data is selected from Unicode 18.0.0 and OpenCC 1.4.2.

summary: Search enhancer that matches equivalent CJK and compatibility characters across Obsidian's native search surfaces without changing note text.
